_comment: Copy this to config.json (or point the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable at a different path). This file holds only two entries: database and skill_dir. Everything else, such as the LLM, is configured through environment variables or the in-app settings and does not go in this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: the ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Pick one of two ways to write it: (A) fill in the individual fields below, or (B) fill in only database.dsn with a complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Option (B): delete the database above and write a complete DSN instead. If dsn is not empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (each subdirectory is one skill and contains a SKILL.md). Precedence: the ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > the default (skills/ next to the executable). If left empty or this field is removed, the default is used. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
_comment_language: Default language for user-facing output (one of en·ko·zh·es·ja). Reports, summaries and chat replies generated by the agent, as well as backend messages, follow this language. Precedence: the ARTEX_LANG environment variable > this field > the default (en). At runtime, the value chosen on the settings screen overrides this default. If left empty or this field is removed, the default (en) is used.
